details:
=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/persist_orchestrator.py:437-526 (also cmd_group lines 561-566) | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: `group_failures` reads a details cache that is missing or partial as "the failure went away" when it really means "unknown". This happens when `_current_wave_details_json` is reset to `'{}'` at orchestrate_poll_process.sh:28180-28183, or when a failed GraphQL batch is dropped at 20731-20737. Every existing `grouped_under` is then released as `journal_absent` or `key_changed`/`owner_key_changed`, and the `persist_group_released_key` cooldown is cleared. `cmd_group` still writes --out while logging "skipped reason=journal_absent".
  WHY: On the next tick with a healthy cache the same items are regrouped as `new`. That posts duplicate "## Paused: same failure as another project item" comments and resets `since: $now`, so the `PERSIST_ORCH_GROUP_MAX_HOURS` release and cooldown never fire. Members are also un-paused for that tick. All reviewers rated this MAJOR (mapped to high).
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:19958-19967 (with 31313-31315) | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: `persist_orch_group_failures` posts a Paused comment for each `new` item once the local STATE_FILE is written. Grouping state only becomes durable later, through `post_state_comment || true`, whose failure is swallowed. Nothing checks for an existing `AI_PERSIST_GROUPED_V1` marker comment before posting.
  WHY: If the comment posts and the state sync fails, the next tick loads stale state without `grouped_under` and posts the comment again, which breaks the "at most 1 comment per newly grouped item" guarantee. minimax adds that owner-change regroupings also post a fresh comment even when `key` is unchanged. Severity disagreement: openai_gpt-6-luna rated NIT; the other four rated MAJOR, and the highest (high) is used.
- scripts/persist_orchestrator.py:637-644 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The shared exception handler in `main()` calls `log("error", "exception_" + type(exc).__name__)`. That emits the `PERSIST orch_context` component instead of the registered `PERSIST orch_group` (`log_group`).
  WHY: Tooling keyed on the contractual `orch_group` prefix never sees crashes in the group subcommand. Behaviour stays fail-open. All reviewers rated this NIT.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:19888-19892 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: When `RUNTIME_DIR` is unset, `pog_base="${RUNTIME_DIR:-/tmp}"` and the fixed names `persist_orch_group_details.json` / `persist_orch_group_out.json` write the comments cache and helper output to predictable, shared /tmp paths. There is no mktemp, no PID suffix and no lock.
  WHY: Overlapping poller runs can race on these files, which can cause wrong grouping decisions, data leaks between runs, or `state_unreadable` errors. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash raised the same issue only as hardening suggestions (~19883-19892). Both findings were rated NIT.
- .github/workflows/orchestrate_poll.yml and other files:CI check-runs | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: The PR failed its pre-push gates: ruff, shellcheck, tests/test_files_touched_scope_guard.py, tests/test_orchestrate_poll_process.py, tests/test_persist_postmerge_verify.py and tests/test_workflow_checkout_integration_ref_audit.py.
  WHY: The code does not meet the repository's CI contract, which blocks a safe merge. Rated BLOCKER.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh / tests/test_orchestrate_poll_process.py:PR gate report | severity=high | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The PR's gate reports 6 failures attributed to this change, but none of them maps to a hunk. The new P8 behavioural tests (`test_persist_orch_group_*`) are Unverified (timeout).
  WHY: Either the attribution is wrong or there is a real failure that static reading does not show, so the PR cannot be treated as green. Rated MAJOR. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 and minimax_minimax-m3 also noted the gate failures as non-findings or observations and suspect misattribution.
- scripts/persist_orchestrator.py:506-510 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: When the existing owner is still in the group, `group_failures()` keeps that owner even if another member has an earlier failing entry.
  WHY: The group's diagnostics and release behaviour then follow the wrong item, which goes against the P8 earliest-failure ownership rule. Rated MAJOR.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: Plan P8 step 2 (docs/plans/persistent-unattended-workflows-plan.md line 526): "add `grouped_items` (titles and keys) to the owner's stall-judge diagnostics"
  expected_change_site: scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh — the `PERSIST_ORCH_GROUP_DIAG_JSON` builder in persist_orch_group_failures (~lines 19949-19955) and the `_fetch_candidate_issue_details_graphql` fragment/transform (lines 20687-20794)
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: `PERSIST_ORCH_GROUP_DIAG_JSON` emits `{issue, id, key}` and uses the local wave `id` in place of the title. The GraphQL fragment (lines 20687-20694) does not select `title`, and the batch_transformed projection (lines 20739-20757) does not keep one. Wave entries in `orchestrate_lib.py` carry only `id`, `github_issue`, `status` and `files_touched`. The agents.d fragment admits the substitution ("Local ids stand in for titles"). Adding `title` to the existing aliased query would cost no extra API calls.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- scripts/persist_orchestrator.py:group_failures, line 440 (journal_seen = journal_seen or bool(entries)), lines 476-485 (elif not journal_seen: reason = "journal_absent" / reason = "key_changed" / reason = "owner_key_changed"), and cmd_group lines 561-566. Applied by scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh persist_orch_group_failures line 19920 (since: $now). | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: A missing details-cache entry is treated as "failure gone" instead of "unknown". This covers a whole-cache reset to '{}' (orchestrate_poll_process.sh:28180-28183) and a dropped GraphQL batch (lines 20731-20736). The whole-cache case gives journal_absent releases and the single-item case gives key_changed / owner_key_changed releases. cmd_group still writes --out even though line 566 logs "skipped reason=journal_absent".
  WHY: Items are regrouped as "new" on the next tick, which posts a duplicate Paused comment, rewrites since=$now (so max_hours release and cooldown never fire) and un-pauses members for that tick. This also contradicts the plan's "skipped reason=journal_absent". Fix: return without writing --out when journal_seen is False, and keep an item's existing grouped_under when its cache entry is absent or comments_available is not true.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:persist_orch_group_failures lines 19961-19967 together with lines 31313-31315 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The "never re-posted" guarantee holds only for the local STATE_FILE, and nothing checks the AI_PERSIST_GROUPED_V1 marker before posting, even though the comments are already in _current_wave_details_json.
  WHY: If post_state_comment fails (the failure is swallowed by "|| true"), the next tick reloads the old state and posts another Paused comment, every tick until a state write lands. Fix: skip the post when a cached pipeline-login comment already contains the marker and the same key.
- scripts/persist_orchestrator.py:main(), lines 640-643: except Exception as exc: log("error", "exception_" + type(exc).__name__) | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: Crashes in the group subcommand are logged under "PERSIST orch_context" instead of "PERSIST orch_group" (log_group).
  WHY: Tooling keyed on the orch_group prefix never sees them. Fix: use log_group when args.cmd == "group".
- TASK_GAP | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  Requirement: Plan P8 step 2 (docs/plans/persistent-unattended-workflows-plan.md line 526): "add `grouped_items` (titles and keys) to the owner's stall-judge diagnostics".
  Expected change site: scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh, the PERSIST_ORCH_GROUP_DIAG_JSON builder inside persist_orch_group_failures, and the issue fragment of _fetch_candidate_issue_details_graphql (lines 20687-20694).
  Evidence of absence: The diagnostics emit {issue, id, key} with id standing in for the title. The fragment does not select `title`, and the batch_transformed projection (lines 20739-20757) carries no title. The agents.d fragment admits the substitution.
- HARDENING (risk score 1) (2 related items): (1) persist_orch_group_failures line 19883 writes the comments cache to predictable shared /tmp paths when RUNTIME_DIR is unset; fix with mktemp. (2) cmd_group lines 565-567 write releases while logging "skipped"; move the journal_seen check before _write.
- NOTES: The pre-push gate failures could not be tied to any hunk, so the editor should rerun them on the PR head. The copilot-pull-request-reviewer failure is an infrastructure error (custom_instructions_too_large). `cause_key` is absent, so the `failure_key` fallback is not a gap.
=== END FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite ===
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:19888-19892 | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: `pog_base="${RUNTIME_DIR:-/tmp}"` and fixed scratch file names are used for caching, which is insecure and race-prone.
  WHY: Concurrent poller runs race on the fixed /tmp files, which can cause grouping errors, information leaks or overwrites.
- scripts/persist_orchestrator.py:438-526 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4

- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:19958-19967; 31313-31315 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: Grouping comments are posted before the state is committed, and the `AI_PERSIST_GROUPED_V1` marker is not checked.
  WHY: When post_state_comment fails (swallowed at line 31314), the next run regroups the items and posts duplicate Paused comments.
- .github/workflows/orchestrate_poll.yml and other files:CI check-runs: ruff, shellcheck, tests/test_files_touched_scope_guard.py, tests/test_orchestrate_poll_process.py, tests/test_persist_postmerge_verify.py, tests/test_workflow_checkout_integration_ref_audit.py | severity=BLOCKER | confidence=5

  WHY: It does not meet the CI contract, which blocks a safe merge.
- scripts/persist_orchestrator.py:637-644 | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: Unexpected exceptions in `cmd_group`/`group_failures` are logged under `orch_context` instead of `PERSIST orch_group`.
  WHY: Log analysis tracking `orch_group` misses crashes in this phase.
- TASK_GAP | severity=NIT | confidence=5
  Requirement: Add `grouped_items` (titles and keys) to owner's stall-judge diagnostics.
